problem_signatures: need criteria for high-quality diagnosis inside HealingFactor closed-loop
need allowed proposal types that remain first-class artifacts only (never raw patches)

need objective multi-metric evaluation harness for successful regeneration: contradiction reduction + resilience lift via graph signals + experience layer coherence + simplicity + future prediction power
self-referential improvement of HealingFactor itself via the same loop

framework.description: Research Constitution for HealingFactor: criteria for high-quality diagnosis, allowed proposal types, objective multi-metric evaluation for successful regeneration. Schema-pack governed, versionable artifact (research-constitution page_type) directly usable by GridEngine, HealingFactor, and daily_consolidation. All in pure AgentDrive language. Self-referential on stabilization-wave-20260531 drive.

mandatory_signals: rich_context from HealingSignalEvent (signal_type, source_component, error_details or equivalent)
Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True, experience_layer_fallback=True) results: gaps, contradictions, graph_hits, damage_signals
explicit run_synthesis call for Gaps + Contradictions clusters + composite scores + fusion_checkpoint
knowledge_graph neighborhood signals (TypedEdge relations including healed_by, strengthened_resilience)
stale_experience_items count from experience layer v3 query
resilience_before score (graph-signal density inverse + contradiction load)
diagnosis_quality_standards: root_cause must be traceable to one or more of the 7 damage signal categories (worker exhaustion, supervisor job failure, reconciliation corruption, synthesis contradiction cluster, security needs_attention, promotion/immune CRITICAL, first-run cold-start)
evidence dict must contain quantitative signals (gap count, contradiction count, resilience_before, graph signal salience summary)
recommended_proposal_types must map to allowed proposal types only
diagnosis must be self-referential: note that the DiagnosisReport itself may become input to future HealingFactor loops
high_quality_diagnosis_criteria.role_swarm_consultation: Drive queries over swarm-artifact page types + daily-present + prior healing_attempt observations for cross-swarm integrity signals before final root_cause declaration.

permitted: experience_consolidation (page_type_hint: daily-present or experience-consolidation; carries fusion_checkpoint + diary_markdown style summary)
healing_attempt_observation (page_type_hint: experience-observation; records diagnosis + execution trace for prevention learning)
immune_rule_update (page_type_hint: genome or schema-pack; extends LineageImmuneSystem known patterns or adaptive memory rules with full provenance)
correction_observation (page_type_hint: experience-observation or synthesis-artifact; high-level concrete correction steps + citations to source genomes/gaps + verification_gates)
safe_evolution_proposal (promotion candidate style with before/after evaluation deltas via graph-signal resilience scoring; schema-pack evolution hints only, no raw source)
forbidden: raw source patches of any kind
direct file writes outside Drive.ingest + promotion + quarantine path
untraced proposals lacking correlation_id and verification_gates
mandatory_proposal_fields: self_referential note: 'This proposal participates in experience layer regeneration and may itself be improved by future HealingFactor loops'

objective_multi_metric_evaluation_harnes.successful_regeneration_definition: A regeneration experiment (healing job under DurableJobSupervisor 'healing' phase) is successful only when all gates pass and post-closure metrics show net positive lift across the five axes. Single-axis regression blocks promotion of the healing_attempt observation into experience layer v3.

contradiction_reduction.measurement: delta in synthesis_contradictions count + contradiction cluster severity (pre vs post via run_synthesis on same query family + experience layer items)
contradiction_reduction.success_threshold: net reduction >= 1 high-severity cluster or >= 30% load reduction; measured via fusion_checkpoint in healing_attempt observation

resilience_lift.measurement: increase in graph-signal density (TypedEdge weight*confidence sums around affected nodes) + new strengthened_resilience edges emitted + LineageImmune incident memory positive updates; resilience_before to resilience_after delta
resilience_lift.success_threshold: delta >= +0.15 on normalized 0-1 scale (or +0.20 in high-damage cases); confirmed by KG query post-closure

experience_layer_coherence.measurement: reduction in stale_experience_items + increase in prefer_experience_layer hit rate + daily-present / living-experience genome density + reduction in gaps returned by Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True) on core coherence queries
experience_layer_coherence.success_threshold: net coherence lift >= +0.12 (composite of recency + graph connectivity + gap load inverse)

simplicity.measurement: net change in framework complexity (number of active steps / rules / genomes referenced in diagnosis family) + reduction in redundant synthesis paths; prefer proposals that consolidate rather than proliferate artifacts
simplicity.success_threshold: simplicity delta >= 0 (no increase) or positive reduction; measured via manifest size + dependency count delta in post-healing genomes

future_prediction_power.measurement: post-closure reduction in recurrence rate of the same damage signal class (tracked via correlation patterns + incident_log in LineageImmune + healing_attempt observation citations in subsequent diagnoses)
future_prediction_power.success_threshold: zero recurrence of identical signal within 24h window in stabilization drive; or measurable drop in prediction error on synthetic replay of pre-closure signals

objective_multi_metric_evaluation_harnes.composite_score: weighted average of the five deltas. Promotion into experience layer v3 as daily-present or living-experience update requires composite >= 0.18 with no single metric below -0.05. Adversary role may challenge any metric computation for robustness.
objective_multi_metric_evaluation_harnes.harness_usage: HealingFactor _execute_proposal_under_durable_healing records pre/post snapshots. GridEngine maintenance loop + daily_consolidation re-run the harness on recent healing_attempt observations. Results feed keep/discard decisions in constrained evolutionary search.

framework.self_referential_improvement: This constitution itself is a candidate for experience_consolidation or immune_rule_update proposals. Future HealingFactor diagnoses may reference this genome for criteria evolution. Ingest triggers research-constitution page_type resolution + KG edges (governs, documents, strengthened_by).

fusion_checkpoint.self_referential: This constitution participates in experience layer regeneration. HealingFactor may diagnose gaps in its own criteria and propose updates via the identical loop.

framework.coordination_protocol_note: Diagnoser role produces DiagnosisReport against these criteria. Proposer emits only allowed proposal types. Verifier runs the multi-metric harness post-execution. Consolidator incorporates successful healing_attempt into daily-present. Adversary may inject synthetic contradiction signals to test harness robustness.

reasoning_patterns.diagnosis_traceability: Every root_cause must cite at least one concrete damage signal + quantitative evidence from Drive primitives.
reasoning_patterns.proposal_safety: Only schema-pack typed artifacts with full verification_gates and self_referential notes are permitted; this prevents framework drift.
reasoning_patterns.metric_balance: No single metric dominates; simplicity and prediction_power prevent over-engineering while resilience and coherence protect the living experience layer v3.

evaluations.constitution_self_test: When ingested, this constitution raises experience layer coherence in subsequent Drive.think(prefer_experience_layer=True) calls on 'HealingFactor diagnosis quality' queries. Measured via daily_consolidation fusion_checkpoint.
